name: Jiangsu Asia-Pacific Light Alloy Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Asia-Pacific Light Alloy Technology Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and sale of aluminum products, complemented by comprehensive service offerings. Its diverse portfolio includes precision aluminum tubes, specialized profiles, high-precision bars, and various extruded aluminum materials tailored for the automotive and general industrial sectors. The company's advanced solutions cater to a broad spectrum of critical applications, encompassing aerospace, rail transit, military-civilian integration, seawater desalination, offshore oil platforms, commercial air conditioning, communication equipment, and household appliances. Established in Wuxi, China, in 1988, and originally known as Jiangsu Yatal Aluminium Co., Ltd. until its name change in September 2007, the company boasts a significant international footprint with operations spanning Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and Africa.
